map.intro: Tap your field on the map, or pick a demo field.
map.label: Map. Tap a spot to add a field there.
map.hint: In Poland a tap adds the land register parcel at that spot. Elsewhere it adds a 200 m by 200 m square (4 ha). Tap a field you already added to select it.
map.tiles.reason: The demo field buttons still work.
